verdict.rationale: First-party SIP trunking docs say users can connect their own PBX or SIP-enabled phone system to ElevenLabs Agents and route calls without changing existing phone infrastructure. That directly avoids being locked to bundled telephony, and the story's 'or' makes number import an alternative rather than a requirement. Missing for 10: any evidence of Twilio/Telnyx number import, configuration depth (inbound/outbound, auth, codecs, carrier compatibility), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can connect my own carrier or PBX via SIP trunking (or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers) instead of being locked to bundled telephony

citations.quote: Connect your Private Branch Exchange (PBX) or SIP-enabled phone system to ElevenLabs' voice AI platform
Route calls to AI agents without changing your existing phone infrastructure
This integration enables all customers to use their existing phone systems while leveraging ElevenLabs' advanced voice AI capabilities.
